slides.title: WHO: northern Ethiopia's health system near collapse
What WHO says
slides.body: Hospitals face shortages of health workers, medicines and equipment. Ambulance services are severely limited.

slides.title: Aid access
slides.body: Insecurity is obstructing delivery of life-saving supplies to some areas. WHO and UN partners are working to send more.

slides.title: What is not known
slides.body: Lives were reported lost in recent days. No overall toll was given and no one was named as responsible.

slides.title: Protect civilians and let health aid through.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
